tools.name: set_oven
tools.description: Preheat or set the oven to a temperature in degrees Celsius. Use get_appliance_status to check on it.

tools.name: control_coffee_maker
tools.description: Control the coffee maker. Never use this for the oven or the dishwasher.

tools.name: start_dishwasher
tools.description: Start the dishwasher, optionally on a stated wash cycle.

cycle.description: The wash cycle; include only when stated.

label.description: Label for the timer, copied from the user.

tools.name: get_appliance_status
tools.description: Read an appliance's current status. This changes nothing; any request to change settings uses the other tools.

cfg.system: date: 2026-09-22 Tue 09:58; Map each explicit supported appliance action to exactly one declared call; never duplicate an action. Do not guess missing values. Unsupported, invalid, ambiguous, and negated requests return no call.
